description: CatBoost agent-tune of the #1 date-aligned cell (russell1000 +50%/200d/dd25%) vs its CatBoost sweep, after resnapping the stale _266-failed #1 bar on the current vintage. _269 follow-up. Date-aligned, test window 2023-07-27..2024-10-03 (test_end 2024-10-03).
metric: R-Precision@K (per-day fixed K, macro over days R_q>0, min(K,R_q) denominator)

bar_was_stale.note: The #1 sweep failed _266's inference faithfulness self-check (max_abs_diff 0.165). Resnapped on current vintage for a fair bar.
bar_was_stale.conclusion: Resnap reproduces the stale bar to the decimal -> the _266 failure was a reproduction-PATH artifact (infer_fresh feature-build path), NOT performance drift. The #1 bar is trustworthy. Same as the _268 resnaps.

verdict: Marginal mixed win: CatBoost-agent edges the (verified) #1 sweep at 4/5 K (@1/@5/@10/@20) but LOSES @3 (-0.055), the board's headline metric. Beats both XGBoost agents at @1/@3 (best agent variant), but cannot clear the cheap CatBoost sweep at @3. Not the sp500/50-style breakout. The CatBoost sweep remains the #1-cell default; do NOT promote the cbagent.
finding: Three agent-tunes (2x XGBoost, 1x CatBoost) have all failed to beat the ≤3-iter CatBoost sweep at @3 on the #1 cell. Eval->test decay -0.157 @1 is the _269 long-horizon disease. Per #26, the @3 loss is a rank-2/3 ranking-shape difference (NOT FS — see investigation_26).

investigation_26.question: Why does the cbagent lose @3 (-0.056)?

per_rank_hit_rate.comment: p_calibrated-ranked, 300 test days; @3 loss localizes entirely to ranks 2-3

investigation_26.fs_hypothesis: REFUTED — cbagent's 53 feats (subset of sweep's 279) retain 92.8% of the sweep's feature-importance mass; all 20 of the sweep's top-20 features survived FS. Same vol/regime model (garman_klass_200, realized_vol_200, index_vol_*). FS dropped only 7.2% low-importance tail mass.
investigation_26.conclusion: The @3 loss is an HP/training-shape effect (agent lr=0.01/depth=4 vs sweep defaults reorders the mid-tail: #2-3 weaker, #4-5 stronger) — not FS, not capacity. Window-dependent, consistent with _271. No-FS confirmatory fit is low-value given the 92.8% retention.

followups: V1.5_TBD #2 multi-window/decay-penalized eval objective (the binding constraint across 5 cells / 2 horizons)
